title: Cart refinement verified at three mobile widths
summary: Reduce address and stepper height and improve product card hierarchy so order details are visible sooner.

changes.detail: Compact horizontal cart progress, tighter address layout, cleaner white cards on a neutral background, stronger product typography, refined checkout button and summary.
Removed repeated address eyebrow and selected badge; retained the selection checkmark and all address controls.

validation.name: Mobile TypeScript
validation.detail: npm run typecheck --prefix mobile completed with exit code 0 after final changes.

validation.name: Responsive visual review
validation.detail: Reviewed screenshots at 320, 390 and 520 pixels, each 900 pixels tall. No horizontal overflow. Sample product price and quantity controls fit above the fixed checkout footer.

validation.name: Quantity interaction
validation.detail: Browser checks incremented quantity from 1 to 2 at all three widths using isolated fixture data.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: Native devices, live checkout/payment, and lint were not tested. Initial browser attempts hit a server timeout and a test locator mismatch; server restart and corrected locator enabled the successful checks. No deployment performed.
